caption: Unpopular opinion: game manuals need to come back. Agree or disagree? #hottake #retrogaming #metalgearsolid #nostalgia #gaming #fyp

instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: game manuals need to come back.

Old Zelda manuals were packed with art, maps and lore to read on the ride home. Metal Gear Solid hid Meryl's codec frequency on the back of the case. The box was part of the game. Sonic's manual told you the whole story of Dr. Robotnik. Today you get a QR code. Agree?
